name: learning-curriculum
description: Project-local concept-map curriculum management using simple JSON files in curriculum/.

/curriculum.description: Display a concise curriculum overview, incorporating learner-state information when available.

/learning-path.description: Display an ordered learning path for a target topic.

/build-curriculum.description: Inspect indexed sources and write a conservative proposed curriculum without overwriting the existing curriculum.

get_curriculum.description: Get a concise curriculum overview or details for one concept.

get_learning_path.description: Propose an ordered path to a target, using curriculum dependencies and learner mastery evidence.

update_curriculum.description: Add or update a concept, append prerequisites, learning objectives, and source references. Does not remove relationships.
